title: Fix dependency filenames containing commas
summary: Fixed handling of dependency filenames with commas by casting install app parameters to arrays before passing them to the pipeline, preventing incorrect path splitting by BCContainerHelper.
key_points: Filenames containing commas were split into multiple paths when processed as strings
Added explicit array casting for installApps and installTestApps parameters
Download Project Dependencies now validates resolved files with Test-Path before output
Missing files generate warnings with full paths but do not break the process
Added comprehensive unit tests covering literal filenames, test-app markers, and error cases
